# M0-a-14 — closing check of consolidation round C1 (lane `check/M0-a-14-consolidate-close-1`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-13)

Lane `check/M0-a-14-consolidate-close-1` ran under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code in a Claude Code cloud container on
2026-10-13, from 20:20 to about 22:40. `tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed
`linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the brief, and Node was v24.12.0.

This seat is an implementer-side independent closing checker. It is not the round's author (`build/M0-a-14-consolidate-1`,
L-0505) and not any earlier seat of the item. Its ledger row is **L-0506**.

How the seat worked:

* It ran no git command and changed no file of the item.
* It ran one test process of its own at a time, sized by `tools/test_budget.py`, which printed 1 every time. It put no
  `--` before a vitest flag.
* It planned its probes and mutants from the plan (kernel-plan.md §0, §1.0, §1.3 T-5, §1.5, §1.10, §2, §3.4, §4, §5), the
  code and the earlier checks' mutant tables. It read the author's round C1 notes only after that.
* Its own mirror is `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-14/plat`, a tar copy of `plat/` without `node_modules`, installed with
  `install --frozen-lockfile` (exit 0). Its `node_modules` was deleted at the end.

**Before-image.** No seat may run git. The pre-round `src/invariants/` and `test/invariants/` were taken from another
checker's scratch copy of `plat/` (`waves/check-M0-a-16/plat`), which was made at 15:20, before the round's first edit at
18:13. Two things show it is the pre-round tree:

* `diff` between it and the tree shows exactly the round and nothing else: π, `uniq`, the `faceArea2` body, the
  `segmentsMeet` body with `sign` / `onSegment`, the `inside` closure, comments, and three new `it`s.
* Its five unchanged sources and four unchanged tests hash equal to the landed record.

## Verdict: PASS

Every failing line of the brief is confirmed with this seat's own evidence, and there is no blocker.

* Each finding V-1 – V-5 is shown equal against its oracle.
* The exported names and types of every index in the owns, and of the barrel, are identical before and after.
* The suite's verdicts on the item's families are byte-identical before and after.
* Every named earlier mutant is killed again.
* Every rewritten comment matches the code.

Four new findings are notes (N-c1-4 – N-c1-7 in `checks/M0-a-14-notes.md`). None is a blocker.
